caption:
"...and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests..."

Surah An-Noor (24:31) - the verse that establishes the khimar (headcovering) drawn over the chest, and lists exactly who a believing woman may reveal her adornment to. Swipe for Arabic, English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an, Surah An-Noor (24), Ayah 31 - built for the requested topic 'what is hijab and what does the Quran and Ahadeeth say about it, and showing neck/earring when wearing the hijab.' This is the primary Quranic verse establishing the khimar drawn over the chest ('jayb'), and the explicit list of mahram/permitted parties before whom a woman's adornment need not be covered. The ayah names the chest ('juyoob') as the specific area the khimar must cover; it does not itself enumerate the neck or ears by name, so on-slide framing states only what the ayah literally says rather than adding an inference about neck/ear coverage not present in the primary text.

sourcing.english: Saheeh International (edition en.sahih), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, quoted verbatim including the translator's own bracketed interpolations.
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian, 马坚 (edition zh.jian), api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above, rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, api.alquran.cloud. Same live call as above - full text returned with no truncation this time (unlike the known 2:286 gap), rendered verbatim with no corrections needed.
